Fiddlesticks

Support Weird but works

Drain-Fear Support Fiddle

How to play this build

In bot, Terrify (Q) locks the enemy ADC and Drain (W) heals you to win trades. Your key moment is Crowstorm (R): use it with Flash onto the grouped enemy team to swing any teamfight.

Skill order

Max priority:

W Drenar → E Viento Oscuro → Q Terror

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Drain (W) for sustain and lane damage; Dark Wind (E) second for poke. Q (Terrify) at 1 point — it's your CC.

Items and what they do

  1. Sightstone Support item granting free ward charges to control vision.
  2. Athene's Unholy Grail AP, MR and mana regen; refunds mana on kills or assists.
  3. Rylai's Crystal Scepter AP and health; your spells slow enemies (helps land everything).
  4. Sorcerer's Shoes Boots with magic penetration.
  5. Zhonya's Hourglass AP and armor; stasis active makes you invulnerable and untargetable for a couple seconds.

Runes

In Season 3, runes were a system SEPARATE from masteries: bought with IP (Influence Points) and slotted into 4 tiers — Marks (red), Seals (yellow), Glyphs (blue) and Quintessences (purple, the strongest). They gave flat stats: damage, armor, penetration, etc.

Marks (red) Magic penetration ×9
Seals (yellow) Armor ×9
Glyphs (blue) Magic resist per level ×9
Quintessences (purple) Gold per 10 (GP10) ×3

Magic pen, mana regen, AP quints

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
9/0/21 — Utility
Why this page
9/0/21 gives mana and utility to sustain drains and reach the ult alive.
